short_description: AI on your phone. Free. Works in airplane mode.
full_description:
AGI runs on your device first. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone for Local Mode.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: responses can be generated by an open-source language model running on your device. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
The default model downloads once over Wi-Fi and runs locally after that. No Local Mode inference calls hit AGI Cloud. Your local conversations stay on this device and are encrypted at rest.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat.

CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE IT
AGI Cloud is in public alpha: sign in for cloud chat and web search on the free tier, with image generation on Pro and above. There are no in-app purchases in this version.

PRIVACY FIRST
We do not claim full DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Our itemised India DPDP notice is published at https://agiworkforce.com/privacy/india, and the obligations we have not met, verifiable parental consent, notice in Eighth Schedule languages, and India data residency among them, are listed at https://agiworkforce.com/trust. AI output is labelled as AI-generated, and first run names the on-device model and any cloud provider. Local Mode collects no personal data by default. Signing in to AGI Cloud uses your account email (and name, if provided by your sign-in method) to create your account. Export or delete your local data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.
Support: support@agiworkforce.com
Privacy: https://agiworkforce.com/privacy

target_audience.note: 13+ is what the binary enforces. The age gate picks a threshold from the device's IANA time zone in apps/mobile/src/features/auth/services/ageGate.ts: 18 for India and Brazil, 16 for EU member-state zones and North Macedonia, and 13 for the United Kingdom and for DEFAULT_RULE, which covers every other time zone and the case where the time zone cannot be read. The lowest age the shipped app admits is therefore 13, not 18, so the youngest declared band must be 13-15. An age below the region threshold puts the install into one-way minor-safe mode, which filters every outgoing prompt against a shared blocklist before it reaches any model and cannot be switched off from inside the app.

data_collected_types.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud (public alpha, open to any signed-in user).
Only if provided by the user's sign-in method when signing in to AGI Cloud.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.
Only in AGI Cloud: photos attached to a message or set as the account avatar are uploaded.
Only in AGI Cloud: documents attached to a message are uploaded.
Only after sign-in: the account identifier carried by every authenticated cloud request.
Only after the user enables push notifications: an app-generated device UUID is registered with the push token. No advertising identifier is collected.

data_safety.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends. Every type is optional because Cloud sign-in is optional: a signed-out user who has completed onboarding lands in Local Mode and is never redirected to a sign-in wall (apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx). The ground fact behind the sharing answer, stated plainly: in Cloud mode the user's messages and attachments leave the device, reach AGI Cloud, and are forwarded server-side to the model provider serving the request. 'Data shared' is answered false on the service-provider basis, the model, storage, auth and push subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors process that data on AGI's behalf, not for their own purposes. What the source tree proves: every outbound request from the device goes to an AGI-controlled host (apps/mobile/lib/constants.ts) plus Clerk for sign-in and the push service, so no third party receives data directly from the device; and apps/mobile/package.json declares no analytics, crash-reporting or ad SDK (no Sentry, Firebase, Crashlytics, Amplitude, PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Bugsnag or Datadog), so no telemetry stream leaves for a third party's own purposes. Whether Play's service-provider exception covers each subprocessor is a contractual question the repo cannot settle; it rests on the data-processing terms behind that subprocessor list. store-listing/android/data-safety.json declares the same seven types with the same sharing and optionality answers, the two files no longer disagree, and REVIEWER-NOTES-ANDROID.md records the same reconciliation for the Play reviewer.

in_app_products.note: Google Play Billing code SHIPS in the v1.2.0 binary and is deployment-gated OFF, so no product is purchasable and has_in_app_products stays false. What ships: expo-iap 5.3.0 is a dependency and a registered config plugin in apps/mobile/app.config.js, so the Play Billing client is linked, and src/features/billing/useMobileIap.ts drives a real purchase flow rendered by src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx. Why nothing can be bought: every purchase path requires GET /api/mobile/iap/catalog to report the catalog as enabled, and apps/web/lib/server/mobile-iap-catalog.ts only does that when MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED is set AND MOBILE_IAP_GOOGLE_PRODUCT_IDS_JSON maps at least one logical product key to a store ID. The gate fails closed in two branches with two different reasons: flag off or unset returns enabled:false with 'Native purchases are not enabled for this deployment.' (mobile-iap-catalog.ts:63-69), and flag on with no product key mapped returns enabled:false with 'Google Play products have not been registered for this build.' (mobile-iap-catalog.ts:77-86). Our deployments are in the first branch. Either way Settings > Billing renders the inert 'Native purchases are not configured' notice in place of the whole native-purchase area, no product row, no store price, no restore action, no store sheet. The checked-in env templates ship MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED=false and define no product-ID map (apps/web/.env.example, apps/web/.env.local.example); the live flag state is a deployment setting this repo cannot prove, and is confirmed off before every submission. The rest of that screen renders the plan card; the plan-change row, whose label is 'Upgrade plan' on the free tier, 'Adjust plan' for an entitled account and 'Choose plan' otherwise (cloud-billing/index.tsx:323-329) and which is suppressed entirely on a Team or Enterprise plan in favour of a 'Workspace administration' row (:331-338) that opens agiworkforce.com/settings/team; the invoices row; for an active web-billed plan only, two static info blocks about proration and how a store top-up would be priced; and, on FIRST PAINT for every signed-in cloud-mode account, a 'Loading native purchases / Connecting securely to the App Store or Google Play' placeholder (:365-370), because nativeIap.loading starts true (useMobileIap.ts:313 with catalogLoading initialised true at :63). That placeholder carries no product, no price and no action, and is replaced by the 'not configured' notice as soon as the gated catalog answers. No Play Console product exists for com.agiworkforce.app: MOBILE_IAP_PRODUCT_DEFINITIONS in packages/contracts/types/src/mobile-iap.ts holds logical keys only, and /api/mobile/iap/verify rejects any product it cannot resolve from that same gated catalog. The plan-change CTA never shows a price or a checkout. handleUpgrade (cloud-billing/index.tsx:165-178) has three branches checked in this order: native purchase (unreachable while the gate is off); subscriptionGuard.blocked, which is true for any entitled account and for any account with a non-terminal subscription recorded against another platform (getSubscriptionOwnerGuard in src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts:56-76) and which fires a native 'Subscription managed elsewhere' alert whose second button opens agiworkforce.com/settings/billing externally (:145-163); and otherwise the in-app PaywallBottomSheet reading 'Plan changes aren't available in the app yet. Check back soon.' (or, for a lapsed paid plan, 'Billing management isn't available in the app yet. Please try again later.') with no action button. A paid reviewer account therefore takes the alert branch, not the sheet. FEATURES.billing is false in apps/mobile/lib/v1FeatureFlags.ts:8 so the web billing-portal link does not render. The full_description sentence 'There are no in-app purchases in this version.' stays accurate only because nothing is purchasable; rewrite it, and flip has_in_app_products, in the same change that registers products and enables MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED. External links: the earlier count of three, and its correction to four, were both wrong. REVIEWER-NOTES-ANDROID.md now carries the complete enumeration, re-derived on 2026-08-27 by grepping every openExternalUrl, openInAppBrowser, WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync and Linking.openURL call site under apps/mobile outside __tests__, nine reachable billing/account-management call sites over seven distinct agiworkforce.com URLs, plus four non-billing ones and the in-app-browser and non-agiworkforce destinations, each with its file and line. docs/agent-context/known-flaws.md records only the first three under MOBILE-IOS-3-1-1-EXTERNAL-LINKS and must be corrected against that section. Play's payments policy allows alternative billing far more readily than App Store Guideline 3.1.1, so the iOS review is the binding one.

release_notes_v1_2_0:
AGI 1.2, Cloud public alpha.

• AGI Cloud is now open to any signed-in user, no invite or waitlist
• Cloud chat and web search on the free tier; image generation on Pro and above
• On-device AI chat still works fully offline, no account needed
• Catalog-selected on-device model downloads once and runs locally
• On-device voice transcription
• India DPDP notice published, with our open gaps listed at agiworkforce.com/trust

Email support@agiworkforce.com, we read everything.
